== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|The [[Holy Wind]] School is one of the four major organizations located in [[Sacred Valley]], each of which claims a specific holy peak as its territory. This school occupies the mountain known as [[Greatfather]], a broken peak characterized by year-round storms and a pool called [[Greatfather’s tears|Greatfather’s Tears]]. This spring is a significant site for the school, as favored elders can use its waters to restore their physical and spiritual vitality. However, access to the spring is strictly regulated; only clan elders may visit, and even then, they must provide substantial gifts. The school also maintains shelters on the mountain slopes to assist travelers caught in the local weather. While the organization has faced periods of instability, including a mass exodus via large floating rafts and a return to their mountain home following various conflicts, they remain a recognized entity within the valley's social structure.}}

== Bloodline ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|Located within the [[Sacred Valley]], the [[Holy Wind]] School is an institution that Eri was accepted into. During a period when [[Lindon]] needed to visit the group, the school was undergoing a mass exodus. This departure involved the members leaving via a massive floating raft.}}
